request: Remove the architect's leftover styles that nothing uses
summary: Every custom style (the document's own, not Word's built-ins) that no paragraph, run, table, list, setting or field uses — and that no used style is based on, followed by or linked to — is removed from the styles; nothing on any page changes.
assumptions: only the document's own (custom) styles are considered; Word's unused built-in styles stay
a style named by a field (STYLEREF, a TOC switch) or by a pending tracked change counts as used
styles.xml only, never tracked; a file with nothing unused is left as it is
